ingredientsText: A few pieces of sugar-cane about 3 inches long, unskinned
steps: Cut the deer into pieces 1 1/2 inches by 1 1/2 inches by 1 inch. Cut the secondary vegetables into small pieces.
Fry the deer in a hot, oiled pan. Turn constantly.
Add the ginger juice, sugar-cane, and a little salt. Add the secondary vegetables and the chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
Add enough primary soup to cover and bring to a boil.
Transfer to a suitable bowl. Put the Fun Wine on top. Steam for 2 hours.
Serve with oil and Chinese sauce.

name: Devil Pot
author: Source author unknown
ingredientsText: three quarts of the best vinegar
a quarter of a pound of eschalots
half a tablespoonful of good cayenne pepper
steps: To three quarts of the best vinegar, put eight ounces of salt, two ounces of ginger, half an ounce of mace, a quarter of a pound of eschalots, one ounce of white pepper, one ounce of mustard seed, and half a tablespoonful of good cayenne pepper
boil it all together and when cold put it into a jar
gather any fruits or vegetables you like, wipe them clean and put them into your pickle
secure the jar closely by tying leather and a bladder over it

name: Digher Vishna Shurubi
author: Turabi Efendi
steps: Put about three pounds of crushed sugar in a stewpan, with two pints of cold water, and the white of an egg, well beaten up
Stir it well, and put it on the fire
When boiling, skim it well, and let it simmer until a little thickish
Add a pound of morella cherries with the stalks taken off, and well washed
Let it boil gently for a few minutes longer, then take it off
When nearly cold, take the cherries out with a strainer, and pass the syrup through a clean cloth
Bottle and cork it up

name: Dimpes Dampes (Appley Slump)
author: Florence Kreisler Greenbaum
steps: Mix one-half cup of sugar, one-quarter teaspoon of salt, two cups of flour and gradually two cups of milk to make a smooth batter
Melt one-half cup or a little less of butter in a large shallow dripping-pan and let it spread all over the pan to grease it well
Pour one-half cup of butter and one quart of sliced apples to the batter
Mix and pour into pan or pans not more than three-quarters of an inch deep
Bake in a moderate oven, thirty to forty-five minutes, until a golden brown

name: Dopenaji of Livers
author: E.P. Veerasawmy
steps: Prepare in the same way as Meat Dopenaji.
Fry the pieces of livers for 10 minutes only.
Leave practically no soup.

name: Drawn Butter
author: Source author unknown
steps: Cut up butter and mix with flour.
Place in saucepan and add hot water.
Cover the pan and place in boiling water.
Move pan around continually in the same direction, till butter is entirely melted and begins to simmer.
Then let pan rest till it boils up.
If set on too hot a fire, contents will be oily.
If not well mixed, the butter and flour will be lumpy.
Avoid too much water.

name: Dried Pork With Fried Bean Cake And Chinese Vegetables
author: Shiu Wong Chan
steps: Cut 1 pound pork into pieces 1 inch by 1 inch by 1 1/2 inches.
Use about 10 bean cakes. Cut each bean cake into 4 pieces. Fry until yellow.
Cut about 3 pounds of any Chinese vegetables into pieces the same size as the pork.
Cook the pork, bean cakes, and vegetables in plain water in an oiled pan for 3/4 hour.
Add Chinese gravy.

name: Dried Shrimp Stew
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: One and one half tablespoonfuls of syou
steps: Soak the shrimps in cold water for half an hour, drain, and cover with cold water, add the cayenne pepper and syou, and boil slowly about one hour.
Mix the rice flour with cold water to a smooth paste, and stir until it thickens.
Serve with rice.

name: Drop Dumplings
author: Florence Kreisler Greenbaum
steps: Break into a cup the whites of three eggs
Fill the cup with milk
Put it with a tablespoon of fresh butter and one cup of sifted flour in a spider
Stir as it boils until it leaves the spider clean
Set aside until cool and stir in the yolks of three eggs
Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg and mix thoroughly
Drop by teaspoons in the boiling soup ten minutes before ready to be served

name: Dry Currie
author: Source author unknown
ingredientsText: a small piece of stick cinnamon
steps: Melt two ounces of butter in a frying pan until it is a little burnt
Mix with it a tablespoonful of currie powder, and let it fry till brown
Put it with very little stock into a saucepan
Cut up your fowl, or any uncooked meat, into pieces
Add a little onion cut very small, three cloves, a small piece of stick cinnamon, three cardamom seeds, and two bay leaves
Let all simmer together for two hours or longer, using very little stock so there should be no gravy when served up

name: Dry Flat Fish Chop Suey
author: Shiu Wong Chan
steps: Soak the dry flat fish for 3/4 hour. Wash thoroughly. Take off a piece of bone on the center of one side of it. On the bone side put knife-marks one-half as deep as it is thick. Then cut into 2 inches by 1 1/4 inches.
Put into the cut flat fish 1/2 teaspoonful of ginger juice, 1 tablespoonful of Fun Wine, 1 teaspoonful of crab juice.
Soak 2 cups of dry mushrooms for 3/4 hour.
Cut 1 cup of celery, 1 pound of any vegetable, a few pieces of pork, and a Chinese onion into pieces 1 1/2 inches long.
Cook the mushrooms, celery, vegetables, and pork in an oiled pan with primary soup until done.
Put the fish into a very hot, oiled pan. Keep turning until it is rolled up like a piece of cigarette. Add the other ingredients and mix well.
Add Chinese gravy.

name: Dry Pork On Rice
author: Shiu Wong Chan
steps: Wash the rice 3 times. Put in a covered pan with 7 cups of water and cook until done.
Place the pork on top of the rice. When dry remove to the back of the stove. Shake the pan frequently to prevent burning. Remove from the stove and keep the cover on for 10 minutes.
Take out the pork and cut into the required size.
Add salt and mix well.

name: Duck Hash
author: Shiu Wong Chan
ingredientsText: 1 duck chopped into pieces as small as possible
1 head of lettuce cut into threads
steps: Fry the chopped duck in a hot, oiled pan. Add the ginger juice and Fun Wine.
Then add the chopped water chestnuts, mushrooms, and bamboo shoots. Mix well. Add enough primary soup to cover and cook until done.
Add Chinese gravy, and salt to suit the taste. Serve on top of lettuce. Use the Chinese ham dice and the fried noodles as a garnish.

name: Duck With Herbs
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: One quarter pound of pork fat
steps: Drain and singe the duck.
Wipe, then thoroughly dry, inside and out, with a clean, damp cloth.
Line a pan with small pieces of pork (fat).
Sprinkle the bottom with minced onion, celery, grated lemon peel, and the garlic, grated fine.
Lay the duck in and cover with a tablespoonful of mixed spices, two tablespoonfuls of syou, and a cup of rich stock.
Set over the fire and simmer for two hours, basting often.
Wash the mushrooms and turn them in, and cook all together for ten minutes.
Take up, and thicken the gravy with cornstarch or rice flour.
Lastly, toss in the chopped parsley.
Cut up the duck in small pieces (not too small), arrange on dish, pour the gravy with the herbs around the duck, and serve hot with rice.

name: Eel or Mossum Braised (Enguia ou mossum estufados)
author: Source author unknown
steps: Scald one or two fresh eels

Place in a casserole lined with bacon slices, a piece of beef, a piece of pork or chopped ham, a handful of carapicús or mushrooms, one garlic clove, one bay leaf, salt, pepper, slices of peeled lemon, and one bottle of white wine
Let boil over coals
When cooked, serve with the strained and reduced sauce

name: Egg and Olive Sandwiches
author: Florence Kreisler Greenbaum
steps: Chop four eggs which have been boiled fifteen minutes.
Add two tablespoons of chopped olives, season and moisten with olive oil and vinegar.
Spread between thin slices of buttered bread.

name: Egg Corn Bread
author: Source author unknown
steps: Scald the meal with boiling water sufficient to melt.
Beat the yolks of the eggs very, very light.
Add the corn meal and melted butter, and the salt, and beat till very light, moistening with the milk.
Then add the whites of the eggs, beaten to a stiff froth.
Beat all well together.
Pour into a buttered or greased pan, or into shallow tins, and bake quickly.

name: Egg Fry with Cauliflowers
author: E.P. Veerasawmy
steps: Cut flowers in small pieces
Boil in water with salt and ground turmeric
Dip into beaten egg contents with salt and ground turmeric
Roll on powdered bread or biscuit
Fry in plenty of ghee or oil
Poppy seeds, minced onions and green chillies may be mixed with egg contents if desired

name: Egg Fry with Flowers of Gourd
author: E.P. Veerasawmy
steps: Remove stalks, placentas and sepals of flowers
Dip into beaten egg contents with salt, minced onions, ground turmeric and besam or rice flour
Fry
Serve while hot and crisp

name: Egg Plant
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
steps: Cut one large egg plant in slices (not too thin).
Soak for two hours in cold water with a handful of salt.
Then drain this off, and pour over the egg plant a little vinegar mixed with water, and let it lie in this for about half an hour.
Then drain thoroughly and pour over it two cupfuls of hot vinegar with dessert-spoonful of mixed spices and one cup of sugar.
Cover tight and put away for at least twenty-four hours.

name: Egg with Meat
author: E.P. Veerasawmy
steps: Wash big pieces of meat
Mix with salt, curd, turmeric, pepper, cumin, coriander, red chillies, garam masala, ginger and onions all ground to paste
Boil ghee and add meat
Allow to simmer until water evaporates
Beat egg contents with salt, powdered turmeric, pasted onion and ginger juice
Dip each piece of meat into egg mixture
Roll on powdered biscuit
Fry in plenty of ghee

name: Eggs in Mask
author: Estella Atrutel
steps: Boil 4 eggs very hard, throw them into cold water for 5 minutes, then peel them
Have ready 1 lb. of forced meat well seasoned, divide it in 4 equal portions
Roll each egg in one piece fixing them well so that you cannot see where the eggs were put in
Press them by putting your fingers in cold water
Chop an onion very fine, a tooth of garlic, salt, pepper, a little grated nutmeg and a few of the dark mushrooms, if you can get them, chopped fine
Put all this in a stewpan with quarter pint of water, let it boil up
Put in the large balls and a few small meat balls, let them cook gently for 1 hour
When done rub in a basin a spoonful of flour with the juice of a lemon, a little browning
Stir it into the saucepan, take out the eggs, put them on a plate
Cut them each in halves, place them in the dish, put round the small balls
Pour the gravy round the dish, be careful not to put it over the eggs
Garnish with parsley
sourceTitle: An Easy and Economical Book of Jewish Cookery

name: Empada de Lombo de Veado (Venison Loin Pie)
author: Source author unknown
steps: Boil a venison loin in water and salt for half an hour, and following that, in white wine, ginger, parsley, and marjoram, until cooked
Afterward, knead four pounds of wheat flour with half a pound of butter, four eggs, and as much milk as is needed to make a dough
Wrap it in this dough and bake in the oven

name: Empanadas de Almendra (Almond Empanadas)
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
steps: Grind one pound of almonds with one pound of sugar, adding orange blossom water while grinding until the paste becomes very soft
Knead the flour with eggs, lard and salt
Form the empanadas with the almond filling and cook them in the oven
sourceTitle: Diccionario de cocina, ó El nuevo cocinero mexicano

name: Encarbonados de Leche (Milk Cakes)
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
steps: Mix a handful of well-ground nixtamal with four cuartillos of milk and sweeten
Strain through a sieve
Cook with a little grated nutmeg or chopped almond and some cinnamon sticks, giving it a higher consistency than that of manjar blanco
When it reaches the proper consistency, cool it well on a platter
Cut small pieces with a knife, removing them carefully so they do not break
Place them on another platter dusted with very fine flour
Put them in a pan on the fire with well-foamed butter, being careful that they do not fall apart or burn
Serve on a platter with ground cinnamon on top
sourceTitle: Diccionario de cocina, ó El nuevo cocinero mexicano

name: Endive
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: a tiny piece of washing soda
steps: Have water boiling hot and salted.
Now put in a tiny piece of washing soda.
Wash the endive, throw it into boiling water, and boil slowly for ten minutes.
While boiling, take one tablespoonful of olive oil and heat it.
Add one tablespoonful of vinegar, a dash of cayenne, half a teaspoonful of sugar, a teaspoonful of salt, and one clove of garlic, chopped very fine.
Let this all simmer for five minutes, then drain off the water, and pour out the endive, and serve.

name: English Guava Jelly
author: Source author unknown
ingredientsText: three quarters of a pound of loaf sugar (for every pint of juice)
steps: Take the stalks off some very fine blackberries
Boil them in a preserving pan until all the juice is extracted, pressing them with a wooden spoon
Strain through muslin
To every pint of juice add three quarters of a pound of loaf sugar
Boil for half an hour or longer, until it becomes a firm jelly, which you may know by dropping some of it on a plate to cool
It must be carefully skimmed whilst boiling

name: Ensalada de Coliflor (Cauliflower Salad)
author: Source author unknown
steps: Cook the cauliflower with salt
Fry chopped garlic in oil and butter
Add the cauliflower there and fry well
Place on a platter
Add oil, vinegar, olives, chiles in vinegar, chopped onion, a little salt, pepper, and a little Chinese oregano dusted on top

name: Eschalot Vinegar
author: Source author unknown
ingredientsText: a quart bottle nearly full of vinegar
half a teaspoonful of Cayenne pepper
steps: Put into a quart bottle nearly full of vinegar, five ounces of eschalots which have been well bruised, and add half a teaspoonful of Cayenne pepper
cork the bottle well, shake it up, and then leave it for a fortnight
at the end of this time, strain it through fine muslin, and bottle it again

name: Essence of Lavender
author: Judith Cohen Montefiore (attr.)
steps: Prepare according to the recipe for Essence of Roses, the lavender being substituted for the roses

name: Et-Suyu
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: five or six pounds of shin of beef or knuckle of veal
three or four quarts of water
steps: Wash the meat well
Put it in a stewpan with sufficient salt, three or four onions cut in four cross-wise, a small stick of celery, and three or four quarts of water
Set the pan on the fire
When boiling, skim it well
Let it simmer until the meat separates from the bones
Pass the broth through a sieve

name: Exotes a la Inglesa (Green Beans English Style)
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
steps: Fry the exotes and when cooked, stir them, allowing the sauce to reduce over low heat
When removing from heat, add a binding of egg yolks beaten with lemon juice or good vinegar
sourceTitle: Diccionario de cocina, ó El nuevo cocinero mexicano

name: Extra White Chop Suey
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: Breast of one and one half pound chicken
One half can of bamboo shoots
One and one half teaspoonfuls of salt
steps: Cut in small pieces the breast of a young chicken of about one and one half pounds.
Put a tablespoonful of chicken fat in a deep frying pan, and heat very hot, then put in the chicken and fry brown, stirring to keep from burning.

Have ready one pound of fresh white mushrooms, cut small; half a bunch of celery, chopped; a dozen water chestnuts, peeled and cut in slices; two white onions, and half a can of bamboo shoots, all sliced.
Add all these to the chicken, and cook for ten minutes.
Add two pounds of bean sprouts, and cook for another five minutes with two tablespoonfuls of syou and a dash of cayenne pepper.
Simmer for five minutes longer, and serve with rice.

name: Farina Soup
author: Florence Kreisler Greenbaum
steps: When the soup stock has been strained and every particle of fat removed, return it to the kettle to boil
When it boils hard stir in carefully quarter of a cup of farina, do this slowly to prevent the farina from forming lumps
Stir into the soup bowl the yolk of one egg, add a teaspoon of cold water
Pour the soup into the bowl gradually and stir constantly until all has been poured into the bowl
Serve at once

name: Filled Lemons
author: Florence Kreisler Greenbaum
steps: Select good-sized lemons
cut off tip to stand the lemon upright
cut top for cover
Scoop out all the lemon pulp, and put in a bowl
put shells in a bowl of cold water
For six lemons take one box of boneless sardines, six anchovies, and two green peppers, cut very fine
Wet with lemon-juice until moist
fill in shells after wiping dry
insert a pimento on top
put on cover of lemon
serve on doily with horseradish and watercress

name: Fillets of Fish
author: Judith Cohen Montefiore (attr.)
ingredientsText: salmon, soles, or other fish fillets
steps: Fry fillets of salmon, soles, &c., of a delicate brown according to the receipt already given
Serve with a fine gravy
If required to be very savory, make a fish forcemeat, and lay it thickly on the fish before frying
Fillets dressed in this way are usually arranged round the dish
Serve with a sauce made of good stock, thickened and seasoned with cayenne pepper, lemon juice, and mushroom essence
Piccalilli are sometimes added cut small

name: Fish Chop Suey
author: Shiu Wong Chan
ingredientsText: 5 pounds pike not less than 2 1/2 inches in diameter
A few pieces of ginger cut into pieces 1/32 inch by 3/4 inch by 1 inch
3 cups bamboo shoots cut into pieces 3/4 by 1 3/4 inches by 1/32 inch
steps: Remove the skin from the pike and take out the bones. Cut into pieces 1/16 inch thick.
Fry the mushrooms, ginger, bamboo shoots, and bean sprouts in a hot, oiled pan for 5 minutes.
Add water enough to cover all. Cook for 15 minutes.
Add Chinese gravy.
Add the pike and mix well. Garnish with parsley, and serve hot.

name: Fish Cofta Curry
author: Source author unknown
steps: Use cold boiled or fried fish which is best adapted for making coftas
Follow the instructions as already given at length in the foregoing recipes
Use mustard oil which is best adapted for fresh-fish curries

name: Fish in Tomato and Oil
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
steps: One day before eating the fish, soak it so it soaks well
The following day wash it and parboil it
Fry it in oil with much chopped garlic
Fry hen also chopped in equal parts of oil and lard
Then add cooked and ground tomato together with garlic and pepper
While frying, add water, salt and let it cook
Let it boil, and near the end add small chiles, olives and cooked onion
sourceTitle: Diccionario de cocina, ó El nuevo cocinero mexicano

name: Fish Soup
author: Shiu Wong Chan
steps: Dress the fish and cook until soft. Take out bones. Tear the meat to pieces (1½ inches long).
Cut the secondary vegetables into dice. Cook for 20 minutes.
Put the vegetables and the fish into the primary soup, and cook for 15 minutes.
Add Chinese gravy. Stir the soup well and take from the stove. Serve in bowls. Garnish each bowl.

name: Fisstik Khdshabi
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: half or a pound of pistachios
a teacup or two of rose-water
steps: Procure half or a pound of pistachios and skin them
Pound the broken and part of the small ones very fine in a stone mortar
Add a teacup or two of rose-water and stir it well
Pass it through a clean cloth into a glass bowl
Mix it with sufficient powdered sugar and water to make a nice sherbet
Add the remaining pistachios and serve

name: Foo Tay Dan (Chinese Ham and Eggs)
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: one half cup of minced ham
one half of a small onion
steps: Heat one tablespoonful of ham fat very hot.
Chop up half a cupful of ham meat; slice thin half a dozen water chestnuts and half a small onion.
Fry all together for five minutes; then beat six eggs, turn in pan, and scramble.

name: Foo Yung Dan (Chinese Omelette with Herbs)
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
steps: Beat four eggs well; have ready half a minced onion and four sticks of celery, chopped very fine.
Put in the frying pan four ounces of pork, chopped fine, and fry until brown.
Now add the herbs, with a dessert-spoonful of syou, and finally the beaten eggs.
Let the whole cook for five minutes, without touching, but be careful to keep it from burning.
Fold one half over the other, and slip on the platter.
Serve at once, with rice.

name: For the Chafing Dish
author: Source author unknown
steps: Soak bread in milk one hour before using.
Cut cheese in small pieces.
Let the cheese melt, cover with paprika, add bread and milk, then the eggs well beaten.
Serve on crackers or toast.

name: Frango Guisado com Carapicú (Stewed Chicken with Carapicú)
author: Source author unknown
ingredientsText: one glass of wine or water
steps: Cook chicken cut into pieces with chopped bacon, salt, parsley, pepper, cloves of India, and onion
When cooked, remove it and strain the broth, reducing it by half
Add a handful of carapicús, juice of one bitter orange, one spoon of tapioca, one spoon of sugar, and three egg yolks mixed in one glass of wine or water
Bring the sauce to a boil, add the chicken pieces, finish cooking, and serve with simple cornmeal mush or with the sauce

name: Frango Refogado em Molho Branco (Chicken Braised in White Sauce)
author: Source author unknown
steps: Soak the chicken pieces in garlic wine for some time
Braise in hot butter until browned
Add one cup of water and one spoon of wheat flour
Add lemon juice and lemon slices
Let simmer until cooked
Thicken the sauce with two egg yolks and serve

name: Frangos à Italiana (Chicken Italian Style)
author: Source author unknown
ingredientsText: two young chickens, cut into pieces
steps: Cut the chickens into pieces and coat with wheat flour
Soak in a mixture of lemon juice, sweet olive oil, salt, bay leaves, and pepper
When flavored, remove and dry the pieces
Pass through grated cheese
Fry in butter and serve

name: French Dressing
author: Source author unknown
steps: Put salt and pepper in bowl, add slowly the oil, stirring all the time.
When salt is dissolved add vinegar.
When well mixed, serve.

name: Fricassee of Oysters
author: Source author unknown
steps: Drain and wash oysters.
Cook until the gills curl.
Drain, saving the liquor.
Add to it sufficient milk to make a pint.
Put butter and flour in a saucepan and mix.
Add liquor and milk, and stir until boiling.
Add salt, cayenne pepper and the oysters.
Heat over hot water.
Beat the yolks of eggs with cream.
Stir them quickly into the oysters.
Take from the fire, and serve on toast, or in a dish, garnished with triangular pieces of toast.
Sprinkle finely chopped parsley over the top.

name: Fried Artichokes
author: Source author unknown
steps: Pluck off the coarse scales of the artichokes, and then throw the vegetable into cold water.
Let it stand for an hour.
Then drain.
Cut the meat into delicate slices, and fry in butter, just as you would potato chips.
Serve with Filet of Beef, Veal Saute, Smothered Chicken, etc.

name: Fried Bamboo Shoots
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
steps: Take one can of bamboo shoots and drain off all water.
Wipe the bamboo shoots dry, and slice in long thin strips.
Have ready boiling peanut oil, and toss the shoots into that.
Cook until crisp.
Delicious. Must be eaten hot.

name: Fried Chicken (Chinese Style)
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: Two and one half pounds of chicken
One teaspoonful of cornstarch or Quong Sang Chong
steps: Clean a young spring chicken, and cut it into small pieces.
Fry to a golden brown in hot, sweet lard.
Serve with a brown gravy prepared as follows: Boil the giblets until tender, then chop very fine and return to the liquor in which they were boiled.
Add a tablespoonful of syou and half an onion chopped fine; boil for ten minutes.
Thicken with a teaspoonful of cornstarch or rice flour, and pour over the chicken.
Serve hot, with rice.

name: Fried Chinese Tomato with Crab
author: Shiu Wong Chan
ingredientsText: Chinese tomato equal in weight to crabs, including shell
steps: Wash the crabs. Open the shell. Steam until they turn red. By means of a fork take off all the meat. Tear it into small pieces.
Fry the tomato in boiling oil until it turns yellow. Then mash into starch.
Fry the crab in a hot, oiled pan.
Add ginger juice and Fun Wine. Turn often.
Add the tomato. Mix well.
Add the primary soup. When all is dry, remove from the stove at once.
Add salt and red vinegar to improve the taste. Garnish with parsley.

name: Fried Chinese Tomato with Shrimp
author: Shiu Wong Chan
steps: Fry the shrimp in a hot, oiled pan.
Fry the tomato in boiling oil until it turns yellow. Then mash into starch.
Add ginger juice and Fun Wine. Turn often.
Add the tomato. Mix well.
Add the primary soup. When all is dry, remove from the stove at once.
Add salt and red vinegar to improve the taste. Garnish with parsley.

name: Fried Eggs Yout Jar Don
author: Shiu Wong Chan
steps: Boil the eggs until hard. Take off the shell without destroying the shape of the eggs. Now fry them in boiling oil.
Cut the mushrooms, chicken, bamboo shoots, and ginger root into threads 1 1/2 inches long. Fry for 5 minutes in a hot, oiled pan.
Pour this over the eggs. Add twice more than enough primary soup to cover and cook until 2 cups of liquid remain.
Add Chinese gravy.
Serve with parsley as a garnish.

name: Fried Fish
author: Shiu Wong Chan
ingredientsText: 6 pounds pike or any fresh water fish
steps: When the fish has been cleaned, rub inside and out with salt. Then fry in boiling oil until it turns brown.
Add enough water to cover. Stir in the vinegar and the cornstarch. Cook for 10 minutes.
Add Chinese gravy.

name: Fried Fish Balls
author: Shiu Wong Chan
steps: Remove the skin from the pike and take out the bones. Run through the grinder three times.
Cut into small pieces the almonds, ham, and the vegetables.
Put the pike into a big bowl and mix with it the cornstarch, 1 cup of water and 1 teaspoonful salt. Stir well for an hour. Be sure to stir in the same direction all the time.
Add the nuts and ham. Mix well.
Make the fish balls as described on the preceding page. Add a beaten egg, and boil in boiling oil until they turn yellow.
Cook the vegetables and mushrooms until done.
Mix together the fish balls, the vegetables, and Chinese gravy.

name: Fried Pigeon
author: Shiu Wong Chan
steps: Clean 6 young pigeons, or squabs, and put them into a bowl of Chinese sauce.
Fry in boiling oil until yellow.
Serve when hot with spicery salt.

name: Fried Rice (Canton Style)
author: Jessie Louise Nolton
ingredientsText: one good-sized bowl of cooked rice
steps: Mince fine small stalk of celery, one small onion, two Chinese potatoes, one cupful Chinese cured pork, and mix with one good-sized bowl of cooked rice.
Fry in oblong cakes in olive or peanut oil, using sufficient well beaten egg to mold the other ingredients into shape.
sourceTitle: Chinese Cookery in the Home Kitchen

name: Fried Rice With Chicken and Mushrooms
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: One pound of cooked flesh of chicken
One pound of fresh white mushrooms
steps: Boil one pound of rice for twenty minutes.
While this is boiling, take one pound of cooked chicken and cut it in small pieces.
Put a tablespoonful of pork fat in the pan, and when it is very hot turn in the chicken and fry for a few minutes.
Cut up two stalks of celery, one onion, and six water chestnuts, and add with the syou cayenne, and salt.
Fry all for ten minutes, then place the rice in a platter and pour the above over it.
Cover tight, and let it soak through the rice thoroughly.
Garnish with chopped parsley, and serve.

name: Fried Rice with Tomato Sauce
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: four tomatoes, or half a can
steps: Cut up the pork and fry brown.
Put in the onion, then the tomatoes and salt and cayenne.
Fry for five minutes.
Turn the rice, which has previously been cooked, into the pan and fry all together for five minutes.
Place on hot platter, and garnish with minced parsley and eggs, threaded.
Serve very hot.

name: Fried Shrimp
author: Shiu Wong Chan
steps: Mix up the shrimp, eggs and cornstarch. Add salt to suit the taste. Put one by one into a pan of boiling oil. Fry until brown.
Cut the green peppers into pieces the same size as the shrimp. Fry in an oiled pan for 2 minutes. Then add the shrimp and mix well.
Add enough primary soup to cover. Cook for 10 minutes.
Add Chinese gravy. Garnish with parsley and serve.

name: Fried Soft-Shell Crab
author: Shiu Wong Chan
steps: Mix the crab with the cornstarch and eggs. Salt to taste.
Fry in boiling oil until golden brown. Serve with the red vinegar.

name: Frijoles Blancos Guisados (Stewed White Beans)
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
ingredientsText: toasted and ground dried broad chile
grated fresh cheese or aged ground cheese
steps: After washing, put the beans to cook in water with clean garlic, sliced onion, and green cilantro.
When cooked, fry more chopped onion in lard and a little toasted and ground dried broad chile to give it color.
Add the cooked beans, separating a handful to grind, and after grinding, add them with the broth in which they all cooked.
Season with necessary salt and grated fresh or aged ground cheese.
Let it boil until seasoned. To serve, decorate with sliced cheese, small chiles, and olives.
sourceTitle: Diccionario de cocina, ó El nuevo cocinero mexicano

name: Frozen Rice Custard
author: Source author unknown
steps: Prepare the rice as in the Rice Cream Pudding recipe, boiled, but omit the fruits and use only the grated rind of an orange in making the pudding.
When cold, add the juice of an orange and the cream, beaten or whipped to a froth.
Four tablespoonfuls of wine or lemon juice may be substituted for the orange juice, according to taste.
Freeze the same as you would ice cream, and serve with an Orange Sauce.

name: Fruit and Nut Cake
author: Source author unknown
steps: Cream butter and sugar
Add well beaten eggs and milk
Chop nuts and citron; flour fruit before adding to mixture
Add flour enough to make thick batter
Bake in slow oven

name: Fruit Punch
author: Source author unknown
steps: Boil water and sugar to a syrup
Add tea, strawberry juice, lemon juice, orange juice pineapple
Let stand for half hour
Strain and add ice water to make one and one-half gallons
Add cherries, mineral water and ice just before serving

name: Fruit Tartlets
author: Florence Kreisler Greenbaum
steps: If using canned fruit, drain syrup and put in saucepan with equal quantity of sugar
Cook until it forms a syrup, then pour in the fruit which has been stoned if necessary
Cook until the whole is a syrupy mass
If using fresh fruit, put two parts sugar to one of water and cook until syrupy
Add fruit which has been peeled, sliced and stoned
Cook until the whole is a thick syrupy mass
Line patty cases or plain muffin rings with puff paste
Put a spoonful or two of fruit in each one
Bake a nice brown

name: Fudge
author: Source author unknown
steps: After milk and sugar are boiling, add chocolate.
Cook until it forms a soft ball in water.
Set out until cooled; then add vanilla and beat until creamy.
Pour into buttered tins.
When set, cut into squares.
Peanuts or pili nuts may be added, less butter with pili nuts.

name: Gai Grun Yung Waa (Bird's-nest Soup)
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: one half pound of bird's nest
one quarter pound of cooked breast of chicken
one quarter pound of minced ham
steps: Boil the bird's nest an hour, then drain and put into cold water
Pound the cooked chicken meat well so as not to be in large or hard pieces
Add a cupful of the cold stock to the chicken meat
Take the bird's nest from the cold water and well drain it
Add the bird's nest to the soup stock
Boil for half an hour
Add the chicken meat, and also the egg, the latter having previously been finely crumbled
Take the soup off the fire as it begins to boil again after the last addition
Before serving, sprinkle the minced ham on top

name: Galinha d'Angola Cozida com Moranga (Guinea Fowl Boiled with Squash)
author: Source author unknown
steps: After plucking and cleaning the bird, boil it in water and salt with one squash cut into pieces with seeds removed
When cooked, remove the pieces of squash, place them on a plate with the skin facing down
Cut the bird into pieces and place them on the squash, drizzling melted butter over all and dusting with sugar
Place the plate in the oven, let it roast for half an hour, and serve

name: Gallina Cocida y Asada a un Tiempo (Chicken Cooked and Roasted at the Same Time)
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
steps: Clean the chicken and cook it.
When almost cooked, remove and lard half of it.
Make a bread soup with broth from cooking the chicken, seasoned with fine spices except cilantro.
Pour this broth into a little butter in which some eyes have been fried, and with this and bread slices form the soup.
Set the chicken with the unlarded part on the soup.
Brush the larded part alternately with oil and lemon using a feather.
Cook over two gentle fires until the top part is roasted and the bottom part is cooked.
sourceTitle: Diccionario de cocina, ó El nuevo cocinero mexicano

name: Gallinas Mechadas y Estofadas (Larded and Braised Hens)
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
ingredientsText: Small whole onions or quarters of large onions
Málaga wine or other generous wine
steps: Clean the hens and lard them throughout with ham, garlic cloves, and cloves.
Fry them in lard and salt in a pot.
Add roasted and ground tomato and small whole onions or quarters of large onions, allowing these to fry as well.
Add ground cinnamon, pepper, and cloves, almonds, raisins, and chopped pineapple.
Cover the hens with equal parts Málaga wine or other generous wine and water.
Cover the pot with a napkin and place a casserole with water on top.
Let the hens boil until they are perfectly cooked and the broth becomes thick.
sourceTitle: Diccionario de cocina, ó El nuevo cocinero mexicano

name: Gallinha com Mólho Branco (Chicken with White Sauce)
author: Source author unknown
ingredientsText: four to six cups of meat broth
lemon slices, peeled and without seeds
steps: Cook the chicken pieces with salt, pepper, a sprig of parsley, onion leaves, and one tablespoon of wheat flour

Separately, make a sauce with four to six cups of meat broth and three beaten egg yolks, one tablespoon of wheat flour, one tablespoon of butter, one tablespoon of sugar, one glass of white wine, and a little nutmeg
Place the cooked chicken pieces in this sauce
Simmer a little longer
Serve with peeled lemon slices without seeds on top

name: Gallinha Ensopada à Italiana (Chicken Stewed Italian Style)
author: Source author unknown
steps: Cook the chicken pieces in half a pound of bacon, half a pound of ham, one onion, two cloves, one bay leaf, a little nutmeg, salt, peppers, one cup of water, and one glass of wine

name: Gallinha Servida Fria (Cold Served Chicken)
author: Source author unknown
steps: Place the cleaned chicken on some slices of bacon with one pound of ham in slices, covered with more slices of bacon.
Place around it a piece of beef foot, one onion, clove, little salt, pepper, parsley and marjoram.
Cover everything with meat broth and boil near the fire for four hours.
Then carefully remove the chicken so it does not fall apart and place it on a plate with the ham around it.
Strain the broth through a sieve and reduce it to a few spoons.
Pour this sauce on top and serve cold.

name: Gar Lu Chop Suey
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: One half can of bamboo shoots
One and one half pounds of bean sprouts
steps: Cut half a pound of pork (not too fat) into small pieces, and fry to a nice golden brown.
Chop into small pieces half a bunch of celery, and wash and soak Chinese dried mushrooms, discarding the stalks.
Chop up one onion, and a very small piece of garlic, chopped very fine.
Season with three tablespoonfuls of syou, salt, and add a dash of cayenne.
Fry for ten minutes, then add half a can of bamboo shoots and fry for five minutes longer.
Lastly, add one and one half pounds of bean sprouts, and cook all together for ten minutes.
Serve with rice.

name: Gato de Papas (Potato Gâteau)
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
steps: Cook the potatoes in steam
Having peeled them, grind them in a metate, adding butter and milk in which sugar has been dissolved
Let everything boil and pour into an earthenware dish where it is left to cool
Conclude everything as in the rice gâteau
sourceTitle: Diccionario de cocina, ó El nuevo cocinero mexicano

name: GhyiHabiye
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: half a pound of fresh butter
a quarter of a pound of skinned almonds
three or four tablespoonfuls of rose-water
steps: Put a pound of loaf sugar in a stewpan, with a pint of water, and set it on the fire

When boiling, add half a pound of fresh butter, a pound of wheat-starch previously formed into a thin batter with water, a quarter of a pound of skinned almonds, and three or four tablespoonfuls of rose-water, mixed with a little musk
Stir it gently until it becomes crummy
Spread it in a rather deep dish, press it all over with the back of the spoon, cut it up in diamonds, and serve with a little sugar sifted over

name: Ghyuldj Baladivessi
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: about a pound of wheat starch
steps: Put in a basin the whites of twenty eggs, and whip them up well
Add about a pound of wheat starch by degrees, stir it well, and mix it well with water, to form a very thin batter

Put over a charcoal fire a circular and slightly-domed sheet-iron, the under side in the centre of which you have previously cemented with ashes half an inch thick, to prevent it from getting fiercely hot

When moderately hot, pour a portion of the batter over the centre, with a convenient spoon, sufficient to form a round cake, the size of a large dinner-plate, or larger, and which will be done in less than a minute; it ought to be very white, and as thin as tissue-paper
Prepare fifty or sixty pieces in this manner
Lay half of them in a suitable baking-tin, one over the other, sprinkling between each piece some rose-water and milk as you lay them
Lay some clotted cream over, a quarter of an inch thick, and shake some powdered sugar over
Cover it with the other half of the cakes, sprinkling rose-water and milk between each one as before
Put in a stewpan a pound of loaf sugar, with two pints of water, and set it to boil until it becomes a syrup
Take it off and pour it over the cakes, till covered, and let it remain covered until cold
Cut it up in diamonds, dish up and serve. Pounded almonds or pistachios may be used, if clotted cream is not handy

name: Ghyulhe-Sheker
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: about one pound of rose leaves
three-quarters of a pint of water
three pounds and a half of white sifted sugar
steps: When the roses are in full bloom, gather about a pound of the leaves.
Pick out the large ones and cut the white ends off with a pair of scissors.
Put the small ones and the white ends in a very clean stewpan with three-quarters of a pint of water and scald them.
Pass the liquor through a piece of muslin or a sieve and squeeze well the leaves and throw them away.
Put the liquor in the pan with three pounds and a half of white sifted sugar.
Stir them with a wooden spoon till the sugar is dissolved.
Add the large leaves that you have picked out.
Stir and boil till rather thick.
Try a little on a plate.
If it sets, remove it from the fire.
When cold, fill the preserve jars and cover them air-tight.
Keep them in a rather cool place.

name: Giblet Paste
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
steps: Boil giblets until they are in shreds.
Crush through sieve, then add the juice of an onion and lemon juice.
Whip lightly with the hard-boiled yolk of eggs.
Serve on crackers, with crumbled yolks of eggs sprinkled on top.

name: Ginger Wafers
author: Source author unknown
steps: Beat the whites of the eggs to a cream and add it to the flour and milk, salt and sugar, molasses and ginger.
Work all well together very light in a bowl, until you have a smooth batter.
Add the brandy and Ginger Extract and beat vigorously ten minutes longer.
Heat the wafer irons over a clear charcoal fire.
Brush the irons with butter.
Place the wafers within and bake on both sides to a light fawn color.

name: Golapi Khechuri
author: E.P. Veerasawmy
steps: Heat the cassia leaves and red chillies with half the ghee and when the chillies turn black drop rice and pulse, washed and dried, and stir for about 5 minutes
Then pour in water and cover the boiling pot
Add salt, turmeric, cumin, pepper and ginger, all pasted or powdered, when the rice are half-boiled
Brown pieces of potatoes and onions in ghee or oil and drop them in the khechuri
Add ghee and powdered garam-masalla before finish
Almonds, pistachios and raisins, peeled and cut in pieces, may be added if desired after browning them in ghee
Mix adequate quantities of rose-water with the khechuri in every dish before serving

name: Gold Cake
author: Florence Kreisler Greenbaum
steps: Take one cup of powdered sugar, one-half cup of butter rubbed to a cream
Add yolks of six eggs and stir until very light
Sift two cups of flour with one and one-half teaspoons of baking-powder sifted in well (sift the flour two or three times)
Grate in the peel of a lemon or an orange, add the juice also
Add three-quarters cup of milk alternately with the flour
Bake in moderate oven

name: Golden Cream Toast
author: Source author unknown
steps: Cut slices of stale bread diamond shaped and toast to a pale brown.
Make a rich white sauce of milk, butter, flour, salt to taste.
Cook until smooth and add the grated yolks of hard boiled eggs and pour over the toasted bread.
Add pepper and mace if the flavor is desired.

name: Grape-Fruit Salad
author: Florence Kreisler Greenbaum
steps: Cut the grape-fruit in halves and remove the pulp, being careful to get none of the tough white skin
Mix with bananas and oranges and stir in white mayonnaise dressing
Remove all skin from the inside of the grape-fruit and fill with the mixture, heaping it high and ornamenting with maraschino cherries
Lay each half in a bed of lettuce leaves and serve

name: Green Peas, Country Style
author: Source author unknown
ingredientsText: 1-8 of a Head of Green and White Cabbage
½ Pint of Consomme of Veal or Chicken
steps: Shell the peas; take three small carrots, one-eighth of a head of cabbage, and one-quarter head of lettuce, and cut into small dice-shaped pieces.
Put a tablespoonful of butter in a saucepan and let the dice-shaped vegetables smother for about fifteen minutes over a slow fire without browning.
Add the green peas and the consomme, and let all cook for a half hour, stirring frequently to prevent burning.
Season to taste with salt and pepper, and use a sprinkling of chopped parsley as a garnish.

name: Green Pepper Beef
author: Shiu Wong Chan
ingredientsText: 2 cups green peppers cut into pieces 1 inch by 1 inch
steps: Cut the beef into pieces 1/32 inch by 3/4 inch by 1 3/4 inches. Mix with the cornstarch oil, sesamum-seed oil, and Chinese sauce.
Put the celery, bean sprouts, and green peppers into a hot, oiled pan and fry for 5 minutes.
Add water enough to cover. Spread the beef on top. Cover tightly and cook until nearly dry.
Add Chinese gravy and mix well.

name: Green Peppers Stuffed with Vegetables
author: Florence Kreisler Greenbaum
ingredientsText: citric acid (size of a bean dissolved in a little water)
steps: Brown large white onions, add one-half cup of uncooked rice, a little salt, piece of citric acid (size of a bean dissolved in a little water)
Fill peppers, stew with tomatoes like Arday-influs
Or fill peppers with red cabbage which has been prepared

name: Groundnut Soup
author: Christian Woman's Exchange
ingredientsText: half a pint of shelled ground nuts
1 pint and a half of water
steps: Beat up the ground nuts well
Add two spoonfuls of flour and mix well
Put to them a pint of oysters and a pint and a half of boiling water
Throw in a red pepper or two if small

name: Guisado de Pulpa Llamado de Regalo (Celebratory Beef Loin Stew)
author: Source author unknown
steps: Wash the beef loin well
Slice it and stud with ham, garlic and all spices
Soak in salted water for one day
The next day soak in vinegar
On the third day have all this together with the meat
Press the meat
Once pressed, cook in a covered pot
When the meat is cooked, slice it
Place on a platter
Add vinegar, olives, capers, oil, chiles in vinegar, ground pepper, and sliced onion
Serve

name: Gum Lu (Golden Cakes)
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: one and one half cupfuls of rice flour
one quarter cupful of mixed nuts, chopped
three teaspoonfuls of clarified goose fat
steps: Take one and one half cupfuls of rice flour and a pinch of salt and into this work three teaspoonfuls of clarified goose fat.
Then chop very fine about quarter of a cup of minced nuts.
Beat the yolks of two eggs, and mix all together.
Now pour in one cup of raw, dark honey.
If too moist, add more flour.
Stir thoroughly for fifteen or twenty minutes, and pour into small cake pans, well oiled, and bake slowly for two hours.

name: Gurnet Stewed with Tomatoes
author: Estella Atrutel
steps: Prepare the gurnet the same as the haddock
Slice the onions and tomatoes at once with 2 spoonfuls of oil, or 1/4 lb. of butter, salt, pepper, grated nutmeg
Use no water to any fish that is stewed with tomatoes
When done, take out the fish
Rub the sauce through a sieve
Add the juice of a lemon and cayenne pepper
sourceTitle: An Easy and Economical Book of Jewish Cookery

name: Haceb-Dolmassi
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: two or three tablespoonfuls of the inside of egg-plants
juice of two or three lemons
steps: Cut off the tops and take out the insides of half a dozen egg-plants
Put them in salt water for ten minutes or so

Mince fine a sufficient quantity of raw mutton, add one or two onions, a little mint, a small quantity of saffron, two or three tablespoonfuls of the inside of egg-plants, all chopped fine, a handful of well-washed rice, a little salt and pepper, mix them well all together with your hands
Stuff the egg-plants with it, and cover them with the tops
Lay some rib-bones of mutton on the bottom of a stewpan, and place the egg-plants over carefully
Cover them with broth, add the juice of two or three lemons
Set the pan on a charcoal fire with the cover over, and let it simmer until the egg-plants are soft, and a nice gravy is formed at the bottom
Dish them up carefully, and serve

name: Ham and Eggs (Canton Style)
author: Jessie Louise Nolton
steps: Cut lean ham into strips about two inches long and one-quarter inch thick.
Beat up three eggs very light, add one cupful strips of ham.
Fry in small cakes like pancakes and serve on oblong platter.
Garnish with strips of Chinese cured pork.
Make a sauce of one tablespoonful Seasoning sauce, mixed with one teaspoonful cornstarch and one tablespoonful hot water.
Pour into pan and heat till thickened, and put around sides of platter.
sourceTitle: Chinese Cookery in the Home Kitchen

name: Ham Omelet
author: Source author unknown
steps: Beat the yolks to a cream and add the other ingredients
Rub all these smoothly together
Add the whites of eggs, beaten to a froth
Beat all thoroughly together
Put a tablespoonful of butter in the frying pan
When it melts add the omelet
Let it stand, shaking occasionally to prevent from sticking to the pan, till the eggs are quite set
Fold as in a plain omelet
Turn into a hot dish and serve

name: Hard Egg Currie
author: Source author unknown
ingredientsText: six or eight hard boiled eggs
steps: Slice two onions, and fry them in butter
Boil them with a tablespoonful of currie powder in a pint of good stock until quite cooked
Then add a cup of cream, and thicken with arrowroot or rice flour
Simmer it slowly for a few minutes, adding six or eight hard boiled eggs cut into slices
Heat the eggs thoroughly, but do not let them boil

name: Hato Shiro (Stewed Pigeon)
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: one half cupful of mirin sauce or sherry
one quarter pound of fat fresh pork
one quarter pound of bamboo shoots
steps: Select good, plump pigeons, and singe and clean thoroughly, then dry.
Rub well with salt.
Take the fat pork and fry out all the fat, and when boiling hot put in the pigeons and brown all over, rolling them on all sides.
Have ready the water chestnuts, washed and cut in thin slices, also the bamboo shoots cut in thin strips.
Chop up the onion very fine, and turn into the saucepan with the pigeons, adding the syou sauce, pepper, salt, and sugar.
Cover very tight, and simmer over a slow fire for one hour.
Then add the mirin sauce, or sherry.
Mix two tablespoonfuls of kudzu starch in cold water, and stir into the juice until it thickens.
Serve with rice.

name: Helados de Almendras Garrapiñadas (Candied Almond Ice Cream)
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
ingredientsText: one and a half cuartillo of water
the same quantity of almonds prepared as in the previous article
steps: Dissolve eight ounces of sugar in one and a half cuartillo of water
Add the same quantity of almonds prepared as described in the previous article
After allowing them to become candied, set them aside
When cold, grind them by rolling with orange blossom water
Continue the operation as described in the previous article
Add the remaining sugar to the milk and custard
Freeze as instructed
sourceTitle: Diccionario de cocina, ó El nuevo cocinero mexicano

name: Helados de Junquillo (Jonquil Ice Cream)
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
steps: Make the same as the previous recipes
Use eight ounces of jonquil instead of violet or tea
sourceTitle: Diccionario de cocina, ó El nuevo cocinero mexicano

name: Hermits
author: Source author unknown
steps: Mix soda and flour, add other dry ingredients and sift
Add butter, eggs slightly beaten and milk
Mold in enough more flour to roll out

name: Hop Ho Gai Din (Fried Chicken with Almonds or Walnuts)
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: Two and one half pound chicken
one quarter pound of white mushrooms
one cupful of almonds or walnuts, blanched and chopped
steps: Use only the breast of a young chicken, and cut it in small tubes.
Fry to a golden brown in two tablespoonfuls of olive oil.
Take a cupful of almonds or walnuts, blanched and chopped, and half a pound of small white mushrooms cut up small; to this add a teaspoonful of onion juice and two tablespoonfuls of syou.
Turn all in with the chicken and simmer half an hour.
Thicken with Quong Sang Chong, and garnish with a border of nuts.

name: Hot Vinegar
author: Source author unknown
ingredientsText: an ounce of ground white pepper
steps: Chop fine two cloves of garlic, put this into a bottle, with a pint of vinegar, a tablespoonful of Worcester sauce, a teaspoonful of salt, an ounce of ground white pepper, and half an ounce of cayenne
Shake it up well, then let it remain for a month
Strain it through fine muslin and bottle it in small bottles, which should be well corked down

name: How to Make Tea
author: Shiu Wong Chan
steps: Heat the water until it just reaches the boiling-point, but no more
Insert a thermometer graduated with centigrade degrees; when it reaches 99° remove from the fire at once
Pour immediately into a half-pint teapot which contains 1 teaspoonful of Chinese tea
Keep covered for three minutes
Serve

name: Huevos Duros (Hard-Boiled Eggs)
author: Source author unknown
steps: Cook with shell and when hard remove and discard shell
Cut into slices and place on a plate
Serve with salt, oil, vinegar and pepper
These are usually served this way to garnish raw salads, plates of asparagus, cauliflower, etc.

name: Imitation Preserved Ginger
author: Source author unknown
steps: Make a syrup with one pound of loaf sugar to four pints of water
Peel a vegetable marrow, remove the seeds and pulp, and cut it into pieces two or three inches in length
Pour the syrup over the vegetable marrow, and let it remain two or three days
Drain it from the syrup, and to each pound of marrow add the juice of one

name: Indian Pickle
author: Source author unknown
steps: Wash the vegetables with vinegar and dry them
Put them on large dishes, sprinkled over with salt, and left for twenty-four hours
Dry them carefully and put into a large jar

Boil as much vinegar as will be required to cover them, putting to each quart of vinegar one tablespoonful and a half of currie powder (or two if the currie powder is not very hot), and an ounce of mustard seed
Pour this vinegar boiling over the vegetables, and when cold tie the jar down, and leave it for twelve hours or longer
Turn the vegetables out of the jar into a large basin, and put them, free of liquid, into smaller bottles for use, taking care to place the tomato skins at the sides of the bottles
Boil the vinegar again, adding more and currie powder in proportion, if you have not enough to fill every bottle quite full, and pour it boiling hot over the vegetables in the bottles
When cold, tie down with bladders; it must be kept a year

name: Individual Apple Dumplings
author: Florence Kreisler Greenbaum
ingredientsText: one and one-half cups of pastry flour
one-fourth of a cup of shortening
three-fourths of a cup of milk or water
steps: Butter six muffin rings and set them on a shallow agate pan which has been well buttered
Fill the rings with sliced apples
Make a dough of one and one-half cups of pastry flour sifted several times with one-half teaspoon of salt and three level teaspoons of baking-powder
Chop into the dry ingredients one-fourth of a cup of shortening, gradually add three-fourths of a cup of milk or water
Drop the dough on the apples on the rings
Let bake about twenty minutes
With a spatula remove each dumpling from the ring, place on dish with the crust side down
Serve with cream and sugar, hard sauce or with a fruit sauce

name: Individual Loaves
author: Florence Kreisler Greenbaum
ingredientsText: dough prepared according to white bread recipe
steps: Make dough according to the white bread recipe
Work small pieces of dough into strands a finger long, and take three strands for each loaf
Make small as possible
Brush with beaten egg or sweetened water and sprinkle with poppy seed
Allow them to rise before setting them in the oven

name: Inhuma, Pato Silvestre, etc. Estufados com Pepinos (Wild Duck Braised with Cucumbers)
author: Source author unknown
ingredientsText: four large cucumbers, peeled and cored
steps: Braise one whole bird in three spoons of fat
Dust it with wheat flour and add one cup of water and one cup of red wine
Add salt, parsley, marjoram, peppers, tomatoes and four large cucumbers, peeled, cut into four pieces and cored
Cover the pan well
Let it cook over coals for two hours
Serve. Alternatively, the cucumbers can be chopped and mixed with the tomatoes to stuff the bird before cooking in the same manner

name: Inja-Burek
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: a pound and a half of flour
minced mutton or cheese or mushrooms
steps: Put a pound and a half of flour on a slab, make a hole in the centre, in which put a teaspoonful of salt and four eggs
Mix all together, then add sufficient water, and form it a softish flexible paste
Dip your hands into melted fresh butter, and work it for a few minutes longer

Divide it into thirty pieces the size of walnuts, sprinkle a little wheat-starch both under and over them, and roll them out one by one with a rolling-pin as thin as a wafer, or thinner than that if you can, and the size of the baking-tin you intend to lay them in

Butter the baking-tin, in which lay five of the pieces of paste one over the other, sprinkle a little fresh butter all over, and lay five more pieces over, butter again, and over which lay five more pieces, butter again

Lay all over either minced mutton, mixed with mushrooms and onions, both chopped very fine, and previously stewed a nice brown in fresh butter, together with the meat, or cheese, or any other ingredients you may fancy
Cover it with the remaining pieces of paste in the same way as before
Cut it in four crossways, pour a little hot fresh butter over, and bake it a nice brown in a moderate oven
When done, dish up and serve

name: Injir Khdshabi
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: one or two pounds of figs
two or three pints of hot or cold water
steps: Cut off the stalks of one or two pounds of figs
Prick each one here and there with a wooden needle
Place them in a basin with two or three pints of hot or cold water
Let them remain for ten or twelve hours
Pass the liquid through a sieve into a glass bowl
Add the figs with a few drops of orange-flower and a few pieces of ice
Serve

name: J. P.'s Currie
author: Source author unknown
steps: Cut up a fowl into small joints and put it into a stewpan with two ounces of butter, and three sliced onions
Let it stew until the meat has acquired a nice brown colour, but do not allow it to get black
Add one pint of boiling stock
Mix one tablespoonful of currie powder and the same quantity of flour, with a little cold water into a smooth paste, and put this into the stewpan
Peel and slice two sour apples (taking out the core), which add to the fowl, and other ingredients
Let all stew gently, for at least an hour
Squeeze into it the juice of half a lemon and serve

name: Japan Cake
author: Christian Woman's Exchange
ingredientsText: 1 teaspoonful of rose water or a nutmeg
steps: Stir together sugar and butter until white
Add 5 beaten eggs, rose water or nutmeg
Add 1 lb. of flour
Drop it with a large spoon on flat tins that have been buttered
Sift sugar over them

name: Jarabe Vinoso de Canela Compuesta (Spiced Cinnamon Wine Syrup)
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
ingredientsText: three-quarters of an ounce of Ceylon cinnamon
one and a half ounces of fragrant rose water
eight ounces of good white wine
steps: Place the aromatic substances in infusion in a vessel with the rose water and white wine for thirty to thirty-six hours
Filter the liquid and dissolve the sugar in it using the heat of a water bath
sourceTitle: Diccionario de cocina, ó El nuevo cocinero mexicano

name: Jigher-Tâvâssi
author: Turabi Efendi
steps: Get a sheep's or lamb's liver, wash, and cut it into large dice
Sprinkle a little salt over
Dip them in flour, and fry them a nice brown in hot butter
When done, take them out and let them drain
Dish up, sprinkle a handful or two of chopped parsley mixed with finely-sliced onions over, and serve very hot

name: Jugged Hare
author: Wyvern (A.R. Kenney-Herbert)
ingredientsText: pint and a half of good strong stock
a dessert-spoonful of red currant jelly
a lump of butter rolled in flour
steps: Skin and clean the hare
Cut the hare up into neat pieces
Dredge them with flour
Give them a few turns in the frying-pan with some butter till they take colour
Prepare beforehand a pint and a half of good strong stock
Choose a vessel that you can close securely with paste
Put the pieces of hare into it, with two carrots, two or three large onions, an ounce of celery, the juice of two limes, a table-spoonful of sugar, and one of salt
Pour in the stock
Throw in a wine-glass of brandy
Seal the vessel as closely as possible
Place it in a pan of cold water
Set it to boil, steaming the covered pot for three hours
When done, open the pot
Stir into it a bumper glass of port, a dessert-spoonful of red currant jelly, and a lump of butter rolled in flour
Serve with a dozen balls of stuffing made as for roast hare, and fried in butter
Alternatively, the jar may be placed in the oven and baked for two or three hours

name: Kabab
author: E.P. Veerasawmy
steps: Mix salt, pastes of ginger, onions, garlic and chillies with minced mutton and keep aside for some time.
Mix it thoroughly with a little ghee and besam of grams to a stiff mass.
Form balls of it, attach them at the end of a pointed iron stick and roast on charcoal flame till brown dropping ghee on them at intervals.

name: Kadin-Budu
author: Turabi Efendi
steps: Mince very fine as much as is required of a leg of mutton, add two or three chopped onions, with a handful or two of rice, well washed, sufficient salt and pepper
knead well, and make it into shapes, as the fleshy part of a leg of capon
throw them in boiling water
When nearly cooked, take them out, and let them remain till cold
beat up four or five eggs, dip the pieces of meat in it, and fry them in hot fresh butter till a nice colour
When done, take them out, and let them drain
Dish up tastefully and serve hot

name: Kapali Bureghi
author: Turabi Efendi
steps: Roll out as thin as a wafer twenty pieces of paste prepared with fresh butter and eggs
Well butter the inside of a shallow and dome-like mould
Lay carefully ten of the pastes one over the other, which must reach up the brim of the mould
Place in a rather deep fryingpan some finely-minced raw lamb or mutton, two or three onions chopped fine, a little salt and a little fresh butter
Set it on the fire, and stew them partly brown
Add one or two ounces of almonds skinned, the same of pistachios, a little pepper and cinnamon
Mix them well together with a wooden spoon
Fill up the mould with this mixture
Cover the top with the remaining ten pieces of paste
Butter the bottom of a baking-tin, in which place the mould upside down
Put it in a hot oven, and bake it a nice brown
When done, turn it out of the mould on to a dish, and serve

name: Karefish Nigore (Sole Jelly)
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: one half pound Kanton (dried seaweed jelly)
steps: First prepare the sole by cutting away the head and thoroughly cleaning and scaling.
Cut in fillets or slices, removing the small bones.
Take one cupful of mirin sauce and a pinch of salt.
Place in pot, and boil only a few minutes.
Chop into small pieces two carrots and about a quarter pound of dried mushrooms (first washed and soaked).
Boil in a small quantity of water, and when tender, strain.
Add the mirin sauce, previously boiled for fifteen minutes.
Wash half a pound of dry seaweed jelly, and soak in water for two hours.
Take out, and squeeze dry.
Break in small pieces, and throw in pan with a quart of water.
Boil and dissolve.
Strain into another saucepan.
Add half a cupful of sugar and a tablespoonful of syou sauce.
With this mix the fish and vegetables, and stir thoroughly.
Transfer to lacquered or smooth wooden box, and let it set.
When it is firm, cut in desired small shapes.

name: Karola or Uch-Chhe
author: E.P. Veerasawmy
steps: Cut the karolas in thin slices and rub powdered turmeric and a little salt.
Heat some oil in a pan till the foams die out.
Add the slices a few at a time so that they may remain merged in oil.
Brown the other side by turning the slices over with any flat utensil like the wrong end of a spoon when one side is browned.
Use slow heat, or the slices will parch in the surface while the interior will remain uncooked.
Alternatively, slices of karolas may be first boiled in water and then fried to make them soft and not crisp.

name: Kawun Bahlawdssi
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: fifteen or twenty pieces of paste (No. 135)
steps: Butter a baking-tin, in which lay fifteen or twenty pieces of paste (No. 135), sprinkling scalded fresh butter between each one
Peel a small musk-melon or any other sweet melon, cut it in two, take out the seeds
Mash one half or the whole of the melon with a wooden spoon
Lay it all over the paste half an inch thick
Cover it with fifteen or twenty pieces of paste as before
Bake it a nice colour
When done, and while hot, shake some powdered sugar over, and serve

name: Kawurmali-Badinjan
author: Turabi Efendi
steps: Cut mutton in pieces and fry them
Bake three or four good-sized egg-plants in an oven
When soft, peel them
Lay them in a pan, over which place the pieces of meat with the fat that is left from it in the stewpan
Add half a pint of broth
Put the pan on a slow charcoal fire with the cover over and let it simmer for twenty minutes
Dish up carefully, sprinkle a little cinnamon and pepper over, and serve while hot

name: Kebab Kyufte
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: two or three pounds of raw leg of mutton, beef, or veal
crumb of a French penny roll
two or three teacups of brown gravy
two or three teaspoonfuls of flour
steps: Put on a chopping board two or three pounds of either a raw leg of mutton, or beef, or veal, half a handful of parsley cleaned, two or three onions peeled, and the crumb of a French penny roll
Sprinkle a little salt, pepper, and cinnamon over, and mince them very fine together until like a paste
Make it up in shapes of small buns, or any shape you may fancy, and fry them a nice colour in fresh butter
Put two or three teacups of brown gravy in a saucepan, with two or three teaspoonfuls of flour, the juice of a lemon, and a little salt
Set it on a slow fire, and keep stirring until it is a nice consistency
Dish the meat up tastefully, and pour the gravy over, and serve hot, or serve it with finely sliced onions and chopped parsley over, instead of gravy, if approved of

name: Kebobbed Currie
author: Source author unknown
steps: Cut up some apples and onions into slices, and some uncooked veal into round slices the same size
Have ready some small skewers and put upon each skewer twelve slices of meat, apples, and onions, alternately
Sprinkle well over them some currie powder
Fry them in a stewpan, with sufficient butter to cover them
Send to table without removing the skewers

name: Kedgeree
author: Florence Kreisler Greenbaum
ingredientsText: about a pound of any kind of cooked fish except herring
steps: Cut up in small pieces about a pound of any kind of cooked fish except herring.
Boil two eggs hard and chop up.

Take one cup of rice and boil in the following manner: After washing it well and putting it on in boiling water, with a little salt, let it boil for ten minutes, drain it almost dry and let it steam with the lid closely shut for ten minutes longer without stirring.
Take a clean pot and put in the fish, eggs, rice, a good dessertspoon of butter, and pepper and salt to taste.
Stir over the fire until quite hot.
Press into a mould and turn it out at once and serve.

name: Kheer of Tal
author: E.P. Veerasawmy
steps: Skin a sweet and ripe tal fruit and separate the seeds.
Beat each a little with the hands and rub against a sieve or a small basket of bamboo or iron placing a plate beneath it.
The pulp of the fruit will be collected on the plate.
The pulp may be used now as it is but it tastes better if it is mixed with a little water and held high in a bag of linen till the whole of the water is drained off in drops.
Heat 1 seer of milk on very mild heat till it is reduced to 3 powas when add 1/2 seer of the pulp and stir constantly.
Take down when the mass is thick and gluey after mixing with raisins, pieces of almonds and pistachios, powders of cardamoms and aniseeds 1/2 tola each and very little camphor.
Serve when cool with bread.

name: Khiyar Turshussu
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: one or two dozen of small cucumbers
steps: Get one or two dozen of small cucumbers
Put some fennel on the bottom of a stone jar
Place the cucumbers over
Lay some fennel on the top
Cover them with salt water
Place a piece of board over them
Put an iron weight or a heavy stone on the top to press it
Put the jar for a few days in a place where the sun is powerful, or in a warm place
Remove it to a cool place
Let it remain eight or ten days before using

name: Khunkyar Pilaví
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: two pounds of the best rice
two pounds and a half of the choice part of mutton
half a pound of fresh butter
three or four tablespoonfuls of pistachios
one or two tablespoonfuls of currants
half a teaspoonful of mixed spice
steps: Wash two pounds of the best rice, put it in a clean cloth, tie it, and hang it up
Cut two pounds and a half of the choice part of mutton in pieces about the size of walnuts, wash and place them in a stewpan with four pints of water, and put it on a charcoal fire
When boiling, skim it well, add sufficient salt, and let it simmer for twenty or thirty minutes
Drain the liquor into a basin, put half a pound of fresh butter over the pieces of meat, and fry them a nice brown

Add three pints of the liquor, with a little salt, three or four tablespoonfuls of pistachios, the same of minced raw mutton, previously fried a nice colour in fresh butter, one or two of currants, and half a teaspoonful of mixed spice
As soon as it boils, add the rice, and boil it for two or three minutes longer
Reduce the heat of the fire by removing the burning coals, and leaving only the ashes and the sparks, put on the pan with the cover over for about an hour
Dish up tastefully, and serve

name: Kid Curry
author: Source author unknown
ingredientsText: a hind-quarter or a fore-quarter of kid
steps: Cut the kid into sixteen or eighteen pieces
Take condiments in the proportion given in recipe No. 16
Cook it in every particular the same as the chicken curry
Allow it to simmer three-quarters of an hour

name: Kiltj Balighti Yahnissi
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: four or five pounds of swordfish
one or two handfuls of picked parsley
five or six cloves of garlic
the juice of two or three lemons
steps: Procure four or five pounds of swordfish in one piece
Cut it in slices, wash them, and sprinkle a little salt over
Dip them in flour and then in egg
Partly fry them in olive oil
Spread one or two handfuls of picked parsley on the bottom of a stewpan with five or six cloves of garlic
Lay the slices of fish over
Spread the same quantity of parsley and garlic on the top
Add sufficient salt and two or three pinches of Cayenne pepper
Add the juice of two or three lemons and two teacups of water
Put the pan over a charcoal fire with the lid on and let it simmer gently for twenty minutes or until the liquor is nearly absorbed
Dish it up and serve

name: Kinoko-Tamago-Yaki (Shrimp Omelette)
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: one half cupful of shrimp meat
one half cupful of syou sauce
steps: Beat up the eggs with half a cupful of syou.
Have ready about four or five small frying pans.
Wipe pans when hot with paper soaked in goma-seed oil.
Pour into each pan an equal quantity of the egg, and quickly divide and scatter in the shrimp meat, which has been finely chopped.
Fry all slowly for four minutes.

name: Kiymbtddn Firm Kebdbi
author: Turabi Efendi
steps: Mince three or four pounds of a leg of mutton, or any other part of raw mutton
Put three chopped onions in a stewpan with some fresh butter, and partly fry them
Add the minced mutton with half a handful of skinned pistachios, the same of currants, a little salt, pepper, and cinnamon
Stir round with a spoon until the minced meat is also partly fried
Cut a caul-fat in pieces about the size of vine leaves
Divide the minced meat in each piece, and wrap it up to the shape of a small cup, or any shape you may fancy
Lay them on a baking tin
Place it in a hot oven until nicely browned
Dish up tastefully, and serve

name: Kopta of Shrimps
author: E.P. Veerasawmy
steps: Remove the scales, etc. from 1 powa of shrimps and make a paste of them
Add 1 chhatak of powdered biscuit, 1/2 tola of powdered pepper, a pinch of powdered mace, 1/2 tola of salt, a little pasted green chillies and 1/2 chhatak of ghee
Mix thoroughly and prepare small balls of it
Dip them into eggs beaten with salt
Roll on powdered biscuit
Fry in plenty of ghee

name: Kuru Silkme
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: three or four pounds of mutton
three or four ounces of fresh butter
steps: Cut three or four pounds of mutton into small pieces
Wash and dry them in a cloth, then place them in a stewpan with sufficient salt and pepper
Set it on the fire, and stir with a wooden spoon until it begins to hiss, which indicates that all the moisture is dispersed
Add three or four ounces of fresh butter, and keep stirring till the meat is nicely browned
When done, take them out with a hand-strainer, and place them in a dish
Keep it hot
Cut three or four egg-plants in thin slices, sprinkle them with salt, and let them remain for a few minutes
When the bitter juice is drawn from them, fry them a nice colour on both sides in the remaining fat from the meat
Arrange them tastefully over the meat, or round the dish, sprinkle a little pepper over, and serve hot

name: Lacum
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: three-quarters of a pound of fresh butter
one pound and six ounces of the best flour
three-quarters of a pint of water
jam or any other jam, clotted cream, or minced meat
steps: Put three-quarters of a pound of fresh butter in a saucepan, and set it on the fire
When hot, add one pound and six ounces of the best flour, and keep stirring till it becomes a light brown
Pour three-quarters of a pint of water over, and continue stirring until it becomes like a paste
Take it off and let it remain till cold
Add about ten eggs, and work it with your hands to form a softish paste
Divide it in round pieces the size of small peaches, hollow the centre of each with the point of your finger
Lay them in a buttered baking-tin, and bake them a nice delicate colour
When done, fill them with the jam, or any other jam, clotted cream, or minced meat, previously stewed brown in fresh butter
Dish them up tastefully on a white napkin, and serve

name: Lai Yut (Beautiful Moon Tarts)
author: Sara Bosse & Onoto Watanna
ingredientsText: one heaping tablespoonful of clarified goose fat
two cups of lychee nuts, stoned and mashed to a pulp
one and one half cupfuls of sugar
quarter of a cupful of crystallized limes
candied orange peel or fruit coloring
steps: Work a heaping tablespoonful of clarified goose fat into two cups of rice flour.
Add ice-cold water slowly to make a stiff paste.
Roll out, brush with the whipped whites of eggs, and fold over several times, each time brushing with egg.
Roll about quarter of an inch thick and cut into rounds about the size of a small saucer.
Put in the filling, and place another round of paste on top.
Press together at the edge, forming a rounded edge, and brush all again with white of egg.
Bake for fifty minutes in a moderate oven, then remove the outer flake, which will leave the tart snow white.
Decorate with a yellow moon in the center, cut from candied orange peel or painted with fruit coloring.

name: Lamb Hash
author: Shiu Wong Chan
ingredientsText: 2 tablespoonfuls Chinese ham cut into dice
steps: Fry the chopped lamb in a hot, oiled pan.
Add the ginger juice and Fun Wine. Then add the chopped water chestnuts, mushrooms, and bamboo shoots. Mix well.
Add enough primary soup to cover and cook until done. Serve on top of the lettuce threads.

name: Lampreado de Tocino (Lampreado of Bacon)
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
steps: Choose very lean bacon shanks, put them to desalt a little, and cook them with pork loins; as soon as they are well cooked, remove them, let them cool and mince them.

Grind saffron, pepper, cinnamon, of each thing the proper amount, and a little toasted clove; incorporate everything with the paste, add raisins, almonds, pine nuts, and beat the paste with eggs in proportional quantity.

Make some small pastries and fry them with eggs, which will be well beaten, giving them two or three layers; put them in the syrup, which will have cinnamon, pepper, little clove and wine. If desired, a little vinegar, toasted sesame, raisins and almonds can be added.
sourceTitle: Diccionario de cocina, ó El nuevo cocinero mexicano

name: Lebre Estufada à Chefe de Cozinha (Braised Hare, Chef's Style)
author: Source author unknown
steps: Remove the loins from two hares
Soak them in salt, garlic, chopped parsley, thyme, pepper, bay leaves, onion leaves, marjoram, cumin, and lemon juice
After twenty-four hours, remove the loins, dry them, and lard them with bacon
Place them in a pan lined with bacon lard strips with half a bottle of brandy and the same amount of white wine
Let everything boil for three to four hours over brisk fire with two pounds of chopped veal meat
Strain and reduce the sauce, pour it over the loins
Serve cold

name: Lechugas Picadas en Leche (Chopped Lettuce in Milk)
author: Source author unknown
steps: Remove tough leaves and veins, wash well
Blanch in boiling salted water
Refresh in cold water
Drain and squeeze well
Chop as the previous recipe
Cook and prepare as for sorrel in milk
Generally nothing is placed on top

name: Leitão Assado no Espeto à Mineira (Spit-Roasted Suckling Pig Minas Style)
author: Source author unknown
steps: The suckling pig is cleaned and washed as was already explained above.
Split it into two halves, with one of them having the head, that is, cut lengthwise, rub it with salt and garlic, leave it in a marinade for twelve hours.
Thread each of these halves on a spit, passing the spit between the ribs and the skin.
As for the half where the head adheres, the point of the spit comes out through the mouth.
Tie the foot to the spit with a cord, and make a small hole in the skin into which the hand is inserted.
In this state, it goes to the oven, resting the point of the spit on a support which was proportioned.

name: Lemon Pound Cake
author: Christian Woman's Exchange
ingredientsText: 15 eggs, leaving out the whites of 3
rind and juice of fresh lemons
steps: Mix all ingredients together and bake

name: Lemunyd Kdymaghi
author: Turabi Efendi
ingredientsText: a pound of strawberries or raspberries
three or four ounces of powdered sugar
two or three tablespoonfuls of water
an ounce and a half of melted isinglass
half a pint of the fruit
a few drops of the essence of rose or orange-flower
steps: Take off the stalks of a pound of strawberries or raspberries, wash and put them in a stewpan, with three or four ounces of powdered sugar, and two or three tablespoonfuls of water
Put the pan on a moderate charcoal fire, and boil till rather thick, stirring it at the same time with a wooden spoon
When cold, pass it through a sieve into a basin, add an ounce and a half of melted isinglass to half a pint of the fruit, and stir it well
Add a pint of whipped cream, with a few drops of the essence of rose or orange-flower; mix well all together
Pour it into a mould, and place it on ice, or in a cool place, until firm
When ready, turn it out and serve

name: Lenguas de Carnero a la Brasa (Mutton Tongues Braised)
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
steps: After washing well the tongues and bleeding them in water, parboil in boiling water, refresh in cold water and let drain
Prepare by removing the gullet, and lard with medium strips of ham
Cook with slices of the same ham, carrots, onions and a mixed bundle of herbs, moistening everything with broth
This cooking should be done over low heat for four or five hours
sourceTitle: Diccionario de cocina, ó El nuevo cocinero mexicano

name: Lenguas de Cordero a la Parmesana (Lamb Tongues Parmesan Style)
author: Mariano Galván Rivera
steps: Cook twelve lamb tongues as described in the previous recipe.
When cool, divide into two halves.
Arrange the pieces on a plate on which grated cheese and thick Spanish sauce have been placed.
Sprinkle with the same sauce and powder with more grated cheese.
Coat with lightly beaten egg white.
Powder a second time with equal parts grated cheese and breadcrumbs.
